hero.title: Learn with calm.
hero.subtitle: When homework stops, STOA helps your child find the next step and keeps teacher-backed support close enough for parents to trust.
hero.proofBody: Teacher-backed support stays available when the question needs more than a hint.

learningThread.title: One route from stuck to understood.
learningThread.subtitle: The page follows one family learning moment, from the question to the next confident step.

beats.title: A real question appears
beats.body: The student brings the confusing step from homework, practice, or a school worksheet.

beats.title: The next step becomes clear
beats.body: STOA keeps the explanation focused on learning, not on instant answers.

beats.title: Teacher support stays nearby
beats.body: When a student needs more help, professional support remains part of the system.

beats.title: Parents see the pattern
beats.body: Parents understand progress and focus areas without taking over the homework.

parentConfidence.title: Close enough to trust. Far enough to let them learn.
parentConfidence.body: A short note gives parents the rhythm of the week, so they can feel informed without sitting over every step.

note.title: Calmer at home
note.body: Your child asked for help at the right moment. Fractions stay the focus for the next study session.

trustLayer.title: Built for serious family education decisions.
trustLayer.body: The trust layer stays compact and restrained, with proof points that support serious family education decisions.

items.title: Swiss-parent first
items.body: The homepage speaks first to parents evaluating daily learning support.

items.title: Teacher-backed
items.body: Support language stays credible and avoids teacher-replacement claims.

items.title: Multilingual ready
items.body: Copy is already separated for later English, German, French, and Italian refinement.

finalCta.title: A quieter way to begin the next study session.
finalCta.body: Begin with a focused study session and a clear route to support when the next step is not obvious.
